refunds.title: Refund Policy
refunds.description: Refund and Return Policy for Kiara Kraft handcrafted marketplace

refunds.customOrdersDescription: Personalized or made-to-order items cannot be returned.
refunds.usedItemsDescription: Products that show signs of use beyond inspection.
refunds.finalSaleItemsDescription: Items marked as final sale during purchase.

refunds.waitDescription: Our team will review your request within 1-3 business days.
refunds.returnDescription: If approved, package the item securely and ship to our returns center.

refunds.internationalOrdersDescription: International customers are responsible for return shipping costs and any customs fees.
refunds.needHelpDescription: Contact our customer service team for assistance with refunds and returns:

shipping.domesticDescription: Available throughout Iran with multiple delivery options:
shipping.freeShippingDescription: on orders over 500,000 Toman within Iran!

shipping.customsNote: International customers are responsible for any customs duties, taxes, or import fees imposed by their country.

shipping.internationalTrackingDescription: International orders are tracked until they reach the destination country's postal service.
shipping.deliveryAttemptsDescription: If delivery fails, we'll make 2-3 attempts. Items may be held at local post office for pickup.
shipping.supportDescription: Questions about shipping or need to track your order?
